description: Encrypts local files on this machine and sends them to one recipient, as you. The recipient gets an email with a link. A recipient with no Armadoc key is emailed an invite instead and nothing is uploaded; once they accept, call this again with the same files to complete it.

expirySecs.description: How long the link stays open, in seconds; default 864000

paths.description: Absolute paths of the files to send

name: send_document
title: Send a document
